brand.name: Easy Pay Direct
brand.description: Payment processing infrastructure for over 100,000 merchants across 13+ years.

colors.__note__: Colors are strictly role-based. Text on dark backgrounds is always the two lightest neutrals (#EBEDF6 or #D1D8E7). Never use a blue as text on a blue background. Never use #000914 as text on any dark surface.

assets.__motif_note__: EPD has ONE motif family (nested rounded diamonds) with FOUR canonical placements. Always prefer the SVG source. The transparent PNG rasterizations exist as fallbacks for image models that only accept raster references.

motif_hero.description: Concentric rounded-diamond outlines fading up from the bottom. Homepage-hero style.
recommended_for: 9:16 social where copy sits above the motif

motif_side_right.description: A single large nested rounded-diamond outline anchored to the RIGHT edge of a section, spilling in from the right.
recommended_for: section backgrounds where copy sits on the left

motif_side_both.description: Nested rounded-diamond outlines mirrored on BOTH left and right edges, framing content in the middle. Deepest-navy variant.
recommended_for: any layout where the motif frames symmetrically

motif_side_both_on_brand_blue.description: The both-edges variant tuned for the lighter #003C7E brand-blue section background. Use where the composition sits on brand blue rather than the deepest navy.

logo_white.description: Primary horizontal lockup, white version. Use on any dark background.

logo_dark.description: Primary horizontal lockup, navy version. Use on any light background.

palette_swatch.description: Labeled palette image. Attach to any image generation call so the model matches actual EPD colors.

typography_specimen.description: Specimen of General Sans + DM Mono at real display, body, and mono sizes.

example_hero.description: Real easypaydirect.com homepage hero. Attach as a positive style reference for any marketing image on the site or a similar layout.

example_section_hero_with_phone.description: Real EPD hero section with phone mockup, showing the both-edges motif framing the content symmetrically.

example_section_testimonials.description: Real EPD testimonials section using the right-edge motif variant (variant B). Shows canonical wide-section treatment with the motif spilling in from the right.

example_section_pricing.description: Real EPD pricing section on the lighter #003C7E brand blue with the both-edges variant D. Shows how the motif is tuned for lighter navy backgrounds.

example_section_application_form.description: Real EPD merchant application form section with the both-edges motif framing content in the middle.

example_social_graphic.description: Real EPD LinkedIn banner (wide 4:1 style). Attach as a positive style reference for wide social banners.

example_social_squares.description: Two real EPD 1:1 square social examples side by side. Left: imagery-driven with people. Right: dashboard-driven. Both use the motif to frame the composition.

example_social_square.description: A finished 1:1 EPD ad with the side motif on the right, headline and CTA on the left, dashboard mockup on the right, and three green-check bullet points. Attach as a positive style reference for 1:1 social crops.

motif_dos_and_donts.description: Reference sheet showing valid motif placements (all four variants A, B, C, D) alongside failure modes (invented diamond shape, high opacity, recolored). Attach when generating any image with the motif.
